structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a stylish townhouse in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant fabric swatch book fanned open on its roof (swatches show only plain colours and simple patterns).
character: young interior design intern (a Black woman in her early 20s, natural curly hair tied up, mustard jumper, tape measure clipped to her belt)
scenes: she pins fabric swatches, paint chips and photos onto a large mood board on an easel, holding a coffee.
she measures a bare room with a long tape measure while noting numbers on a clipboard (abstract lines only).
she works at a desk on a laptop showing an abstract 3D room layout made of simple blocks.
she unpacks sample boxes of tiles and wood flooring, laying them out on a big table to compare.
she presents a neat sample board to a smiling client at a small round table; dusk through the window.
props: a giant paint roller, colour wheel, armchair silhouette, pendant lamp, pot plant, ruler, a winding tape measure

steps.title: Mood boards

steps.body: Measure rooms and note windows and doors.

steps.body: Plan the space in a design program.
